open_findings.text: REQ-1 residual assigns catching a smuggled file in the close commit to the user reading the PR diff — contradicts PRINCIPLES.md Non-negotiables 1-2 and the 'Won't do' line; the close commit needs a machine review, not a user diff read (same substance as spec-R8, which is therefore not closable by disclosure)
Acceptance #3 negative case covers altered byte and extra file only; deletion and mode-only plumbing changes promised by REQ-3 are unverified (spec-C8 partly reopened)

'closed is terminal' overstates: a branch that never carries the close commit (forked from trunk before the merge, or rebased around it) has an empty -S history and current status confirmed, so intake passes

reopen check uses a literal single-space pickaxe -S'status: closed' while the grammar regex may be whitespace-lenient; a hand-edited double-space closed line parses as closed but never matches the pickaxe
Path(__file__).resolve() test: a symlink or copy of the checker placed outside .codex/hooks/ flips the exemption on even on Codex, falsifying 'no exemption applies'
'canonical is whichever checkout the hook invoked' lets a deliberately older cached plugin version serve as canonical, so plumbing matching superseded weaker content escapes trailer duty
